shared_elements: boat/ship in profile with upturned prow and stern
crew strokes rendered as short vertical lines along a hull line
quadruped animal in profile with stick legs
schematic outline figures pecked/painted on rock surface
multiple vessels stacked in horizontal registers
justification: Both surfaces show the same highly specific motif: a profile boat with curved, upturned prow and stern whose hull line carries a row of short vertical crew strokes, repeated in loose horizontal registers alongside a schematic stick-legged quadruped, all in the same flat, outline-only, pecked-line convention. B is denser and adds elements absent from A (a human figure with raised arms, and a large grid/ladder-like rectangular framework filling the lower half), whereas A is sparse with only a few isolated ships and one animal.
